title: Argentinian-Style Beef Skillet
description: A hearty beef skillet recipe inspired by Argentinean cuisine, featuring kissed beef and a yeasty crust.

ingredients.name: beef (1.5 lbs)
ingredients.notes: Flank steak or skirt steak work well for this recipe

ingredients.name: skillet
ingredients.notes: Cast-iron skillet ideal for this recipe

ingredients.name: yeast (1 tsp)
ingredients.notes: Active dry yeast or instant yeast work well

ingredients.name: kissed (1 tsp)
ingredients.notes: Assumed to be a type of salt or spice; adjust as needed

instructions: Season the beef with salt, black pepper, and kissed.
Heat the olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 130°F (54°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let the beef rest for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, onion, and tomato to the skillet and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are softened.
Add the red wine and beef broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Sprinkle the yeast over the sauce and let it dissolve.
Serve the beef with the sauce spooned over the top and garnished with fresh parsley.
